equipment.label: Padded Tunic
equipment.description: A quilted cloth tunic worn as a base layer under armor or alone.

equipment.label: Cloth Robe
equipment.description: A simple cloth robe. Offers negligible protection but is comfortable and light.

equipment.label: Leather Jerkin
equipment.description: A tough leather vest worn over the torso. Stiffened by boiling or waxing.

equipment.label: Studded Leather Jerkin
equipment.description: A leather jerkin reinforced with metal studs and small plates.

equipment.label: Chainmail
equipment.description: A shirt of interlocking metal rings. Requires a padded layer underneath.

equipment.label: Scale Shirt
equipment.description: Overlapping metal scales riveted to a leather backing. Good protection for its weight.

equipment.label: Standard Shield
equipment.description: A wooden or metal shield worn on the arm. Provides DR when actively blocking.

equipment.label: Buckler
equipment.description: A small center-grip shield. Lightweight and allows a weapon or item in the same hand.

equipment.label: Tower Shield
equipment.description: A massive shield covering most of the body. Grants half cover to adjacent allies. Requires considerable strength.

equipment.label: Brigandine
equipment.description: Small metal plates riveted between layers of leather or cloth. Flexible and protective.

equipment.label: Breastplate
equipment.description: A formed metal plate covering the chest and abdomen. Often worn over chain or padding.

equipment.label: Plate Cuirass
equipment.description: A full steel cuirass covering the torso. Requires considerable strength to wear effectively.

equipment.label: Full Plate
equipment.description: Complete plate armor with integrated greaves and pauldrons. The pinnacle of protection.

equipment.label: Cap/Hood
equipment.description: A simple cloth cap or hood. Offers minimal protection but keeps the elements at bay.

equipment.label: Coif
equipment.description: A chainmail hood covering the head and neck. Requires a padded cap underneath.

equipment.label: Helmet
equipment.description: A formed metal helmet protecting the head and face.

equipment.label: Gloves
equipment.description: Simple cloth or leather hand coverings. Minimal protection.

equipment.label: Gauntlets
equipment.description: Armored metal gloves protecting the hands in combat.

equipment.label: Shoes
equipment.description: Simple leather or cloth footwear. No combat protection.

equipment.label: Boots
equipment.description: Sturdy leather boots reaching to the mid-calf. Light protection for the feet.

equipment.label: Greaves
equipment.description: Metal leg guards protecting the shins and knees. Part of heavy armor sets.

equipment.label: Cloak
equipment.description: A heavy wool or leather cloak. Offers warmth and can carry enchantments but negligible DR.

equipment.label: Backpack
equipment.description: A sturdy backpack for carrying gear. No protective value.
